## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

### Policy `install`

`install-my-element-<cluster>`: Install and configure the example operator.

| Template | Action | Severity | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-my-element-instance` | inform | medium | `install-my-element-status`<br>compliant while pending | [my-element-instance](converters/install/my-element-instance.yaml) | Operator configuration |
